title: Shortcut Conflict shown when there's no documented conflict.
author: gungfujoe

status.label: Ready for design investigation
status.detail: The false-positive Win+Shift+C conflict is reproducible on the latest stable release and narrowly scoped.

next_action.label: Queue focused design
next_action.reason: Investigate system-shortcut normalization and matching without requesting more reporter evidence.

judgment.rationale: The report is reproducible, current, narrowly scoped to shortcut-conflict detection, and does not require more reporter information before code investigation.
evidence: Win+Shift+C is reported as a system conflict while the linked Windows shortcut documentation contains no matching shortcut.
The configured Color Picker shortcut continues to work, indicating a detection false positive rather than an actual registration conflict.
The reporter reconfirmed the behavior after updating to PowerToys 0.101.2362.
judgment.recommended_action: Queue a focused design investigation into system-shortcut normalization and matching for Win+Shift+C.
